blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — When Jude Bernard Villarba Miñoza finally saw his name at No. 1 on the Civil Engineers Licensure Examination list, he had to pinch himself to make sure he was awake. For five days after the exam, the Cebu Institute of Technology–University (CIT-U) graduate barely left home, disconnected from social media and waited for the results with one hope that the years of work he had poured into becoming a civil engineer would not go to waste. He had not prepared himself to be the country’s top examinee. He was only hoping to pass. That hope says as […]...
